summary: Iteration 74: Blog Section Testing - All 15 test cases PASSED. Verified 14 SEO-optimized blog posts at /blog and /blog/:slug routes. All blogs have proper H1 tags, TL;DR sections, tables, FAQ sections, author attribution ('Founder & CEO, GetMyPlan' - no personal names), JSON-LD Article schema, internal cross-links, related articles, and CTA buttons. Blog pages are publicly accessible without authentication.

TEST_01_blog_index_loads.notes: Blog index page loads at /blog with data-testid='blog-index-page'

TEST_03_category_filters.notes: 6 category filters work: All(14), Software Reviews(2), How-To Guides(4), Industry Concepts(2), Data & Research(1), KPIs & Metrics(3), AI & Technology(2)

TEST_05_featured_blog.notes: Featured blog section visible with data-testid='blog-featured'

TEST_06_blog_post_renders.notes: Individual blog posts render correctly at /blog/:slug

TEST_07_h1_title.notes: Each blog has exactly 1 H1 tag with proper title

TEST_09_tables_present.notes: All tested blogs have <table> elements in content

TEST_11_author_attribution.notes: Author shows 'Founder & CEO, GetMyPlan' - NO personal names like 'Ayush'

TEST_12_json_ld_schema.notes: JSON-LD Article schema injected with @type='Article', author='Founder & CEO, GetMyPlan', publisher='GetMyPlan'

TEST_13_internal_crosslinks.notes: Internal blog links (/blog/slug) navigate correctly between posts

TEST_14_related_articles.notes: Related Articles section shows 3 related posts at bottom

TEST_15_cta_buttons.notes: CTA 'Start Free Trial' buttons navigate to /signup

TEST_16_navbar_blog_link.notes: Resources dropdown in landing page navbar has Blog link that works

TEST_17_footer_blog_link.notes: Footer Company section has Blog link that works

TEST_18_no_auth_required.notes: Blog pages are publicly accessible without login redirect

TEST_19_404_handling.notes: Invalid slug shows 404 page with 'Blog post not found' and 'Back to Blog' link

TEST_20_sitemap_blog_urls.notes: sitemap.xml contains 14 blog URLs plus /blog index

test_credentials: No auth needed - all blog pages are public routes
seed_data_creation: None required - blog data is hardcoded in blogData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74 verified all 14 SEO-optimized blog posts. Blog section is fully functional with proper routing, content rendering, JSON-LD schema, internal linking, and public access. Author attribution correctly shows 'Founder & CEO, GetMyPlan' with no personal names. All category filters and search work correctly.
